title: Sentence Embedding Models for Ancient Greek Using Multilingual Knowledge Distillation
reasoning: The paper uses religious texts (New Testament and Septuagint) as linguistic corpora to train and evaluate sentence embedding models for Ancient Greek. However, it does not evaluate religious beliefs, theology, morals, or ethics; the section on 'Translation Bias' focuses on linguistic translation styles (e.g., literal vs. archaic vs. paraphrase) rather than faith-based or ethical evaluation.
